html:
Samora Machel was the commander of FRELIMO's guerrillas and the first president of Mozambique, from independence on 25 June 1975 until his death in a plane crash in 1986.

A former nurse, he took over FRELIMO after the murder of Eduardo Mondlane. In power he made Mozambique a Marxist one-party state, nationalised land, schools and health care, and backed the guerrillas fighting Rhodesia and the ANC.

Rhodesia and then South Africa answered by backing the RENAMO rebels in the civil war. In 1984 he signed a non-aggression pact with South Africa. In 1986 his plane crashed just inside South Africa, and many suspect the apartheid government. His widow Graça Machel later married Nelson Mandela.
